draft.title: Organisations that help consumers
card: ACCC
The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission is a national agency. It enforces the Australian Consumer Law across the country and can take businesses to court.
NSW Fair Trading
a NSW government agency. It takes complaints about businesses in the state, helps both sides sort out a dispute and can act against businesses that break consumer laws.
Ombudsman
an independent service that looks into complaints about a particular industry, such as banking or energy, usually after the business has had a chance to fix the problem.
The ACCC and NSW Fair Trading also warn the public about scams and unsafe products. The ACCC runs the Scamwatch website for this.
draft.remember: These organisations take complaints, enforce consumer laws and warn people about scams.

a.q: Dev bought a faulty phone in Newcastle. The store would not help, so he wants a NSW government agency to help sort out the dispute. Who should he contact?
opts: NSW Fair Trading
The Scamwatch website
A banking ombudsman
A court in another state
a.why: NSW Fair Trading is the state agency that takes complaints about businesses in NSW and helps both sides sort out a dispute. Scamwatch warns people about scams, so it is not the place for a dispute over a faulty phone.
a.clue: Which option is a government agency for the state?

b.q: Priya has a complaint about her energy provider. The company has tried to fix it but she is still unhappy. Which step suits her best?
opts: Take the complaint to an energy ombudsman service
Ask the ACCC to enforce the law for her alone
Report the energy provider to Scamwatch
Wait for NSW Fair Trading to send a scam warning
b.why: An ombudsman looks into complaints about one industry, such as energy, usually once the business has had a chance to fix the problem. The ACCC enforces the law across the country, so it is not set up to settle one person's complaint.
b.clue: Which service deals with complaints about one industry?

b.best: Take the complaint to an energy ombudsman service
